name: Subscripted Population Model (Massachusetts Towns)
description: Restores all 351 Massachusetts towns and their original populations from the native Vensim source. Population is the statewide total. Every Population[Town] series is retained as a named output. Identical birthrate 0.1, lifespan 70, and order-8 exponential delay make each regional system linear and proportional to its initial population, so exact factorization of the 351 independent systems uses one aggregate population and one eight-stage delay chain. Each town output is its original initial fraction times the statewide population. This is not a single-town approximation or truncated data list. Source initial list, town ordering, and nine-state independent reference are retained in tests/fixtures/corpus-v19-b. Native DELAY N(input,time,initial,order) is mapped to DELAY_N(input,time,order,initial). Start 0, end 20 and Euler step 1 match the source. Source controls say Month despite lifespan 70; no empirical demographic calibration is claimed.
reference: Native Vensim model, SDXorg test-models commit 21aab02739dc5187bc9564e4d3de14e575905d2f; Vensim DELAY N documentation https://www.vensim.com/documentation/fn_delay_n.html
